building.completed_conflict: The assessor's roll gives 1932 and the 2017 Corbett Heights context statement 1931; a permit was applied for on 20 November 1931 and the house recorded complete on 21 December 1932.

historical_record.description: The ground is part of lot 15 of the 1864 McKee subdivision — 45 feet on 17th Street by 110 feet on Clara Avenue, the street later renamed Ord. By the time the house went up its lot measured 69 feet by 35.
A house designed by Albert Joseph Fabre, working in the partnership Fabre & Hildebrand.
The empty lot was bought in September 1931 from E. A. Janssen, a building contractor.
A permit for the frame dwelling was applied for on 20 November 1931, at an estimated cost of $7,000.

Recorded complete on 21 December 1932: a Zigzag Art Moderne design, with sunburst panels in the projecting bays, a stepped gable over the garage opening and a double zigzag band along the parapet and chimney.
Recognised by the Art Deco Society of California in 2003.

hook: A Zigzag Art Moderne house of 1932, permitted the November before at an estimated $7,000.
